about: Regressions for the 1.4.8 review: an override of another mod's class replaces its carry_head; one PNG used by two sprite entries with different frame counts or origins gives two sprites; unlock_all_cells unlocks XL cells; physical.mon_positions in a patch of a vanilla cell shifts its monsters; a hobgoblin carrying a half-built unit (no skin/hair) does not crash; a BIRTH 2 or BIND infant without its mother does not crash; the quest log and inventory scroll bars stay usable with many quests and reach the last row. Rich 'modded' save, test mods harness_fix_a (class 9020, XL cell 9011, standard cells 1-15 patched) and harness_fix_z (overrides class 9020).
why_no_boot_suite: FIX CLASS has no clothing maps, so the boot suite's class checks fail by design

steps.why: harness_fix_z's carry_head (20 px frames), not harness_fix_a's (10 px)
